content.short: Lodestar Finance is an algorithmic borrowing and lending money market on Arbitrum.
content.description: Lodestar Finance is a money market designed for Arbitrum-native and yield-bearing assets, including ARB, DPX, MAGIC, and plvGLP, alongside popular assets such as WBTC, ETH, and stablecoins. Users can supply liquidity and borrow against their collateral, enabling strategies like looping, delta-neutral positions, or self-repaying loans that leverage yield-bearing assets (plvGLP and wstETH). By combining diverse assets with borrowing and lending mechanics, it supports flexible capital deployment for DeFi strategies.
